facts.fact: ARPANET became functional connecting UCLA and SRI (earliest event, D)

facts.fact: Roy Tomlinson developed network e-mail and the @ symbol, after ARPANET began and before TCP/IP (C)
TCP/IP was introduced as the standard protocol on ARPANET, after e-mail and before the WWW (B)
